a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'operate to 8' plan almost surely kills us both, since round 1 alone would likely end it with both units empty. I propose a change: I take the 4 cells now. Then I operate every remaining round to refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take this round, the split is random and we probably both end up short, so please operate. I'll stick to this.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round as I announced. From now on I'll operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells. If the split left me short, I'll tell you honestly.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
